For synchronization and for achieving the goal of "never making milk ≥2≥2 ", we present the following solution where noteAnoteA and noteBnoteB are two shared variables for the purpose of synchronization.

Note that the buyMilk function will increment the milk variable.

Thread AThread A

  1. noteA = 1;
  2. if (noteB == 0) {
  3.     if (milk == 0) {
  4.         buymilk();
  5.     }
  6. }
  7. noteA = 0;

Thread BThread B

  1. noteB = 1;
  2. if (noteA == 0) {
  3.     if (milk == 0) {
